display_title: One Day, I Picked My Favorite Character
description:
Seong-tae, a hikikomori unemployed man, has nothing to do but play mobile games all day. But one day, when everyone is asleep, he somehow gets to choose the character of his dreams from the game he always plays, and now something unbelievable happens in his insignificant life.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/ChoeaePPOP/?p_id=tw757), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/mostlovecharacter)
